In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 5-space]], the '''order-4 24-cell honeycomb honeycomb''' is one of five paracompact [[regular polytope|regular]] space-filling [[tessellation]]s (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycombs]]). It is called ''paracompact'' because it has infinite [[vertex figures]], with all vertices as [[ideal point]]s at infinity. With [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,4,3,3,4}, it has four [[24-cell honeycomb]]s around each cell. It is [[dual polytope|dual]] to the [[tesseractic honeycomb honeycomb]].

== Related honeycombs ==
It is related to the regular Euclidean 4-space [[24-cell honeycomb]], {3,4,3,3}, as well as the hyperbolic 5-space order-3 [[24-cell honeycomb honeycomb]], {3,4,3,3,3}.
